name: Love*Love Amelia-ryou e Youkoso♪
original_name: LOVE*LOVEアメリア寮へようこそっ♪
source:
There are four stories about love of student Leon and teacher Amelia in the Magical Academy. Magic is used to add kinkiness to their erotic play.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
收录四篇发生在“魔法学园”中学生雷昂与女教师阿梅莉亚之间的恋爱短篇。奇妙的魔法更为两人的闺房情趣增添了别样刺激。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
